"""Owned stdlib supervisor for the final repaired tiny CPU verification."""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import os
import signal
import subprocess
import time
from pathlib import Path
from typing import cast

ROOT = Path("/Users/teilomillet/Code/wyat")


def digest(path: Path) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def main() -> None:
    core = cast(
        dict[str, object],
        json.loads(
            (
                ROOT / "benchmarks/analysis/results/cpu-readout-core-review.json"
            ).read_text()
        ),
    )
    production = cast(dict[str, str], core["production_source_sha256"])
    paths = [ROOT / name for name in production]
    paths += list((ROOT / "benchmarks/analysis/torch/projection").glob("*.py"))
    paths += [
        ROOT / "tests/analysis/cpu/projection/test_qkv.py",
        ROOT / "docs/analysis/cpu/projection.md",
    ]
    before = {str(path.relative_to(ROOT)): digest(path) for path in paths}
    failed = [
        ROOT / "benchmarks/analysis/results/torch-qkv-primitive.wall.json",
        ROOT / "benchmarks/analysis/results/torch-qkv-primitive.log",
    ]
    failed_before = {str(path.relative_to(ROOT)): digest(path) for path in failed}
    command = [
        str(ROOT / ".venv/bin/python"),
        "-m",
        "pytest",
        "tests/analysis/cpu/projection/test_qkv.py",
        "-q",
    ]
    started = time.perf_counter()
    child = subprocess.Popen(
        command,
        cwd=ROOT,
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
        stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
        text=True,
        start_new_session=True,
    )
    timeout = False
    try:
        stdout, stderr = child.communicate(timeout=60)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        timeout = True
        os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
        stdout, stderr = child.communicate()
    after = {str(path.relative_to(ROOT)): digest(path) for path in paths}
    receipt: dict[str, object] = {
        "command": command,
        "cwd": str(ROOT),
        "pid": child.pid,
        "cap_seconds": 60,
        "elapsed_seconds": time.perf_counter() - started,
        "exit_code": child.returncode,
        "timed_out": timeout,
        "reaped": child.poll() is not None,
        "stdout": stdout,
        "stderr": stderr,
        "source_before": before,
        "source_after": after,
        "source_unchanged": before == after,
        "failed_initial_parent_files_before": failed_before,
        "failed_initial_parent_files_after": {
            str(path.relative_to(ROOT)): digest(path) for path in failed
        },
        "producer": {
            "path": str(Path(__file__)),
            "sha256": digest(Path(__file__)),
            "text": Path(__file__).read_text(),
        },
        "runtime_scope": (
            "Tiny CPU/property/fake worker only; no released checkpoint/model/GPU work"
        ),
    }
    output = ROOT / "benchmarks/analysis/results/torch-qkv-focused-repair.json"
    with output.open("x") as handle:
        json.dump(receipt, handle, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
        handle.write("\n")
    print(
        json.dumps(
            {
                "receipt": str(output),
                "sha256": digest(output),
                "exit_code": child.returncode,
                "stdout": stdout,
                "stderr": stderr,
                "elapsed_seconds": receipt["elapsed_seconds"],
                "source_unchanged": receipt["source_unchanged"],
            }
        )
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
